lines: The old woman's name is Echo. And she is *eight hundred* years old.
She takes your hand, and the world speeds up. Villages... kingdoms... towers of glass... *all gone*.
The future is bright with neon. And then it is quiet, and green, and *empty*. People forgot there was ever a city here.
Echo says there is a way to stop being immortal. One way. But it only works... if two people choose it *together*.
So what if the cure for forever... needs you to say goodbye to someone you *love*?
Follow and comment... for part four!
